parameters.name: NeedStatusNotify
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable callbacks for recording status. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

parameters.name: NotifyUrl
parameters.description:
The callback URL that is used to receive notifications about recording events and status.

> 

*   The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`.

*   You must use URLEncoder for encoding. This way, the system can identify Chinese characters, spaces, and special characters.

parameters.name: OnDemandUrl
parameters.description:
The callback URL for on-demand recordings.

> 

*   The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`.

*   You must use URLEncoder for encoding. This way, the system can identify Chinese characters, spaces, and special characters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-record-notify-config --domain-name example.com --notify-url http://learn.aliyundoc.com/examplecallback.action --on-demand-url http://guide.aliyundoc.com/ondemandcallback.action --need-status-notify false --notify-req-auth false --notify-auth-key testkeyyourkey12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live UpdateLiveRecordNotifyConfig --region cn-hangzhou --DomainName 'example.com' --OnDemandUrl 'http://guide.aliyundoc.com/ondemandcallback.action' --NeedStatusNotify false --NotifyUrl 'http://learn.aliyundoc.com/examplecallback.action' --NotifyReqAuth false --NotifyAuthKey testkeyyourkey12
